provenance.pivots: Anatomical pin centers selected in a calibrated side rendering and raycast onto the textured scan; outboard pin surfaces recentered along the transverse axis. Approximately 5-10 mm landmark uncertainty; video fitting is used to validate/refine these.
provenance.scale: OBJ units assumed metres; envelope agrees approximately with toy specifications. No ruler or metric calibration target provided.
provenance.ranges: Simulation limits relative to scanned rest pose, not measured mechanical hard stops. Boom observed about -33 to +10 deg. Bucket envelope expanded to accommodate video poses; total 180 deg remains a provisional prior.
provenance.dynamics: Boom speed and approximate slew/stick/bucket rates informed by video; mass allocation, motor torque, latency, friction and backlash remain unidentified priors. Randomize for RL; validate on hardware before transfer.
provenance.actuation: Velocity-limited electric motor surrogate, with finite torque, delayed ternary commands and holding feedback. Not a hydraulic model.
provenance.tracks: Stationary base in 2- and 4-joint profiles. Mobile profile uses differential-drive wheel proxies; actual belt deformation and slip are uncalibrated.

calibrated_from.note: Generated by python -m digital_twin.sim.build --calibrated; do not edit by hand. Anchored at the homing stops (no absolute stop angles were measured).
